name: hcportal_getCountries
description: Returns a list of all countries from HC.Country, ordered alphabetically by CountryName. Used for populating country dropdowns in the portal. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (device-bound token, NULL callerParamString); no kennel permission gate — any authenticated portal user may call it.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of the result rowset on auth failure or a runtime error from the CATCH block.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text (NVARCHAR(255) from ValidatePortalAuth), validation message, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block

rowsets.name: CountriesResult
rowsets.description: Every row in HC.Country ordered by CountryName — removed countries (Country.Removed = 1) are NOT filtered out.

columns.name: NeighboringCountries
columns.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes for this country and its neighbours; used as the gazetteer countryCodes filter when a run overrides its country. Default ''.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block (line 53) returns the Success=0 envelope with ERROR_MESSAGE() but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure (timeout, deadlock) is invisible server-side unless the API shim logs it. CLAUDE.md: every CATCH must log to HC.ErrorLog.
Line 48-50 selects all of HC.Country without WHERE Removed = 0, unlike hcportal_getCities which filters City.Removed. A retired country would still appear in portal dropdowns.
